summary: Durable local memory with tag/keyword/time recall, stored in the plugin's own append-only journal.

configuration.description: Explicit data directory; defaults to <plugins root>/.data/keel.context-memory and then <cwd>/.data.

providers.description: Recall/store seam behind the remember and recall tools; a different backend can serve the same port without changing the tool names.

examples.title: Remember a fact
examples.description: Append one memory with optional tags.
examples.snippet: {"text":"The bi-weekly release train leaves on Thursday","tags":["release"]}

examples.title: Recall by keyword
examples.description: Search the journal; an empty query returns the most recent entries.

limits.name: max_text
limits.description: One memory text is bounded to 20k characters.

limits.name: max_tags
limits.description: At most 32 tags per memory; each tag is at most 64 characters.

limits.name: max_results
limits.description: Recall returns at most 50 entries per call.
